entries: 1985 – Microsoft Windows 1.0, the first graphical personal computer operating environment developed by Microsoft, is released.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1805 – Beethoven's only opera, Fidelio, premieres in Vienna.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1820 – An 80-ton sperm whale attacks and sinks the Essex (a whaling ship from Nantucket, Massachusetts) 3,200 kilometres (2,000 mi) from the western coast of South America. (Herman Melville's 1851 novel Moby-Dick was in part inspired by this incident.)
